messages:
noor: Heads-up — HelixCare wants to run a POC for a new variant (helix-16b-slimmed) for triage chat + long-context embeddings. PHI in scope. Can we onboard and what's realistic timeline + cost for ~120M gen tokens + 8M embed tokens/mo?

rafael: Not seeing helix-16b-slimmed in catalog. We can onboard but need artifacts: model weights (HF or presigned S3), tokenizer files, license terms, ~1k sample prompts, a couple long-docs, and their target latency SLO. Also confirm if embeddings will be persisted.

priya: From infra: "slimmed" likely means aggressive quantization. We'll try q4_k / q5_k candidates. For long-context (>=16k) we need to validate KV cache and memory per token; 32k changes GPU choice. Ask for sample doc length distribution.

nate: Security: PHI => Private or Dedicated with BAA. Required: KMS-managed keys, audit logs, network isolation. If embeddings store PHI require encrypted indices + RBAC. I'll need their DPO contact and a simple data-flow diagram. Legal addendum for BAA usually 2-3 weeks  flagging as possible blocker.

oli: Cost note: hosted list for that volume is high. Options: committed Dedicated capacity or hybrid routing (embeds hosted, gen on Dedicated). Need peak concurrent streams and avg tokens/response to give a concrete committed vs hosted sketch.

onboard-bot: onboarding-checklist: artifacts_required, tokenizer, sample_prompts, max_context, license_info uploaded -> pending.

rafael: Proposed quick plan: 1) get artifacts + tokenizer + 1k prompts; 2) tokenizer roundtrip + edge-case checks; 3) smoke forward pass; 4) quant candidates + perf sweep (A100/H100); 5) quality evals on clinical extraction; 6) recommend deployment (Private/Dedicated if PHI); 7) canary then SLA.

noor: They asked if we can validate in 5 business days after artifact handoff. Realistic?

priya: If artifacts are clean: tokenizer + smoke + initial perf in 2 business days. Quality + extraction eval + basic safety checks add ~2 days. If 32k tuning required add +3 days. So optimistic 5 business days, realistic 7-8.

nate: Also: if they need a Private deployment, legal + infra provisioning will add time. Recommend we start security questionnaire in parallel.

rafael: Tokenizer sanity snippet to include in onboarding checklist:\n```\npython -c "from transformers import AutoTokenizer; t=AutoTokenizer.from_pretrained('path/to/tokenizer'); samples=open('samples.txt').read().splitlines()[:200]; lens=[len(t(s)['input_ids']) for s in samples]; print('avg_len', sum(lens)/len(lens))"\n```\nAnd smoke forward pass:\n```\npython -c "import torch; from model_loader import load_model; m=load_model('path/to/model'); x=torch.randint(0,32000,(1,128)); print(m(x)[0].shape)"\n```\nThese catch tokenizer mismatches and missing weights.

oli: Once we have avg seq length and peak rps I will produce a hosted vs committed cost sketch and show break-even point.

noor: Can someone own perf sweep? Rafael or Priya? If Rafael owns customer comms I can loop them in. I will request artifacts & prompts now.

priya: I can own perf/quant sweep. Please provide presigned S3 link (read-only). Ill run a small matrix and post latency/p99/mem-per-token.

cost-bot: note: tentative suggestion -> hybrid routing reduces gen unit cost by ~25-40% at these volumes (placeholder until detailed sizing).

noor: Thanks team. I'll collect artifacts and DPO contact and schedule a sync for Fri. Marking blocker: BAA/legal timeline. :thumbsup:
